narrative:
Wyandot County has 14,407 registered voters, with 51.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 9.4%, a pronounced Republican lean of 29.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.2% of registrants.
